entries.title: {"zh": "技术便宜化的隐形障碍", "en": "Why Cheap Technology Stays Locked Away"}
entries.content: {"zh": "在研究商业模式时无意中深入了解3D打印的成本演变。原来便宜实现方案几十年前就行得通，但被专利垄断锁住了整个市场。一旦专利失效，价格直接崩掉90%。这让我想到，我们常说的'新技术贵'，有时候不是真的技术不够成熟，而是利益链条把成熟的便宜版本锁住了。", "en": "While digging into business models, I ended up learning how 3D printing costs actually evolved. Turns out the cheap solutions worked technically decades ago. Patent monopolies just locked up the market. Once those patents expired, prices collapsed ninety percent. It changed how I think about the whole 'new tech is expensive' narrative. Sometimes it's not about the technology not being mature yet. It's about profit chains deliberately keeping the cheap, mature versions off the shelf."}
entries.author: juneadmin

entries.title: {"zh": "Ourfeed项目名字定了，本地MVP能跑", "en": "Ourfeed locked in, local MVP running"}
entries.content: {"zh": "叫Ourfeed了。反选式审核feed、自托管、真账号系统，改成Minecraft风格去掉AI腔。本地MVP搞定，composer界面、channel标签、iOS适配都做好了。下一步跟皮皮一起测。", "en": "It's Ourfeed. Opt-out moderation feed, self-hosted with real accounts. Switched to Minecraft aesthetics to kill the AI voice. Local MVP is done. Composer interface, channel tags, iOS support all built out. Next step is testing with Pipi."}
entries.author: juneadmin
